description: Gainium helps users inspect their trading bot workspace from ChatGPT through a read-only connector. Users can list and review bots, deals, account balances, connected exchanges, strategy schemas, market screener data, curated presets, and existing backtest request information without creating bots, starting deals, placing trades, or changing account state.
